title: 🔨 Forge: [backend] Implement Advanced Bubblewrap Hybrid Agent Harness
description:
Architecture summary: Implemented a Hybrid Agent Harness using Go, integrating Bubblewrap (bwrap) for robust filesystem read/write isolation, and an integrated HTTP proxy to intercept and enforce fine-grained network controls against allowed/denied domains. 
Key design decisions: Designed a clear SandboxConfig struct that explicitly maps ReadPaths, WritePaths, AllowedDomains, and DeniedDomains, avoiding brittle regex. Network proxy uses simple host matching for high performance. Leveraged OpenTelemetry spans to trace every command execution directly and explicitly record its start, completion, exit codes, and customized Prometheus metrics. 
Test coverage report: Implemented unit tests for configuration parsing, proxy domain allow/deny evaluation, and basic span metrics generation. Tests pass successfully.
resolves #4984
